description: Live, bookable offers for up to 15 hotels and one stay. Every room in stay.rooms must have the same party: for different parties, call once per party. Each offer has the room, the meals included, price.total, in the request's currency, for the whole stay and every room (what is charged), fees payable at the property, the cancellation terms with times in UTC and the hotel's time zone, the confirmation mode, and an offerId for book_hotel that expires at expiresAt. Hotels with nothing to offer are listed under unavailable with the reason. Up to limitPerHotel offers per hotel (default 15), picked to span price, free cancellation, breakfast and rooms, listed cheapest first; the answer counts those not shown.

currency.description: The currency of every price: USD (default) or CNY. Each currency is paid through its own channel, with its own payment methods; the order's payment page shows them. CNY is paid through payment channels in mainland China and suits a user who pays that way. An order made from these offers is charged in this currency.

requireBreakfast.description: Keep only offers that include breakfast.

requireFreeCancellation.description: Keep only offers that can still be cancelled free of charge.

hotelIds.description: Hotels to price, 1 to 15, no repeats.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

stay.description: Dates and party. One party per call: every room must be the same.

checkIn.description: Check-in date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd.

checkOut.description: Check-out date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd. Stays are 1 to 15 nights; a longer one answers stay_unsupported (max_nights), and past 30 nights invalid_request: ask the user whether to split it into consecutive stays.

rooms.description: The rooms wanted, 1 to 8, each with its party; offers and orders need every room the same.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child in this room, 0 to 17. An empty list means no children.

name: get_hotel_offers

cancellation.description: The cancellation terms, read at asOf.

asOf.description: When these terms were read: status and penalties are as of this time.

confirmation.description: How the hotel confirms a booking of this offer.

mode.description: instant: the hotel confirms the booking as soon as it is made. on_request: the hotel confirms or refuses it later, within withinMinutes when stated. unknown: not stated.

withinMinutes.description: For on_request, the minutes the hotel takes to confirm; null when instant or not stated.

meals.description: What the rate includes to eat. known false: the meals are unknown, not none, and included, unspecifiedMainMeals and allInclusive are null.

guestsCoveredPerRoom.description: How many guests in each room the meals are for; fewer than the guests in the room means not everyone gets them. null when not stated.

unspecifiedMainMeals.description: Main meals a day beyond included that the rate doesn't name (e.g. 1 when a half-board rate doesn't say lunch or dinner); null when known is false.

payAtProperty.description: Fees paid at the property, on top of price.total, in the property's currency, not converted. disclosure incomplete: there may be fees not listed.

perNightAllRooms.description: price.total divided by the nights: all rooms, one night. A search's fromPerRoomNight is for one room; divide by roomCount to compare.

omitted.description: How many offers each selection step left out.

byNationality.description: Offers left out because the hotel sells them only to guests of some nationalities; Fortrip can't book them.

dominated.description: Offers left out because another offer of the same room is as good on price and every term, or can't be told apart from one kept.

unreadable.description: Offers left out because their details came back incomplete or inconsistent.

anyOf.description: How many offers each selection step left out.

byNationality.description: Offers left out because the hotel sells them only to guests of some nationalities; Fortrip can't book them.

dominated.description: Offers left out because another offer of the same room is as good on price and every term, or can't be told apart from one kept.

unreadable.description: Offers left out because their details came back incomplete or inconsistent.

reason.description: Why the hotel has no offers: sold_out (nothing left for the stay), no_matching_offers (the filters left none), nationality_restricted (the hotel sells this stay only to guests of some nationalities; Fortrip can't book it), offers_unreadable (its offers came back incomplete or inconsistent), not_found (Fortrip has no bookable hotel with this hotelId), supplier_unavailable (offers couldn't be fetched this time; try again), stay_in_past (check-in has passed in the hotel's time zone).

title: Live offers
